# Wonka AI

> Wonka AI is a Belgian company providing an enterprise AI workspace, connected agents and AI implementation services. The website serves English, French and Dutch-speaking audiences, including the French market.

Wonka Workspace (also called WonkaChat) brings multiple AI models and business integrations into a shared workspace. Start AI helps frame use cases and adoption; Wonka Build addresses custom implementation needs. Availability, hosting, integrations and commercial terms depend on the selected offer and configuration. Consult the linked product, security and pricing pages for the current scope.

## Product and services

- [Workspace](https://www.wonka-ai.com/): product overview.
- [AI chat](https://www.wonka-ai.com/workspace/ai-chat): chat workspace.
- [Odoo](https://www.wonka-ai.com/wonka-chat/odoo): Odoo use cases and integration.
- [Start AI](https://www.wonka-ai.com/start-ai): strategy and adoption.
- [Wonka Build](https://www.wonka-ai.com/wonka-build): custom AI development.
- [Security](https://www.wonka-ai.com/security): data and security information.
- [Pricing](https://www.wonka-ai.com/pricing): current offers.
- [Customer stories](https://www.wonka-ai.com/case-studies): published customer evidence.

## France — contenu en français

- [Accueil français](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr): espace de travail IA pour les entreprises.
- [IA pour entreprise](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/ia-pour-entreprise): guide des usages et du déploiement.
- [France](https://www.wonka-ai.com/france): accompagnement du marché français.
- [Diagnostic IA](https://www.wonka-ai.com/france/diagnostic): cadrer un projet.
- [Audit IA](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/audit-ia): prioriser les cas d'usage.
- [Odoo et IA](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/wonka-chat/odoo): intégration et processus métier.
- [Sécurité](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/security): données et contrôles.
- [Tarifs](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/pricing): offres actuelles.
- [Comparatif IA entreprise](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/comparatif-ia-entreprise): méthode de choix.
- [Comparatifs](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/vs): guides par concurrent.
- [Wonka et ChatGPT](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/vs/wonka-ai-vs-chatgpt-enterprise): offres professionnelles et workflows.
- [Wonka et Claude](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/vs/claude): écosystème Anthropic et choix des modèles.
- [Wonka et Dust](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/vs/dust): agents, intégrations et gouvernance.
- [Wonka et Langdock](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/vs/langdock): plateformes européennes et adoption.
- [Blog](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/blog): articles en français.
- [Glossaire](https://www.wonka-ai.com/fr/apprendre): définitions IA.

The comparisons are published by Wonka, one of the vendors compared. Each guide identifies its sources and review date. They are not independent model benchmarks. Belgian incorporation, service to French customers, storage location and processing location are distinct concepts.
